s1.desc: a living room drawn on a plain greyish-lavender background

spans.view: with a cream sofa, and a teal coffee table and a wooden crate blurred in the foreground

beats.text: Pax and Polly sit side by side on the sofa with their feet sticking out, looking ahead
Polly closes her eyes and snuggles into Pax's side, wrapping her flippers around his flipper
Polly hugs Pax's flipper and gazes up at him with big shining eyes while he looks ahead and blinks
Polly nuzzles her cheek against Pax's flipper, glancing up at him now and then, while he sits still
Polly opens her beak and chomps down on Pax's flipper while he keeps staring ahead
Pax squeezes his eyes shut and flings his free flipper out to the side
Pax cries out with his beak wide open and his eyes shut while Polly keeps gnawing on his flipper with a content face
